svg.title: Black White Black
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and standardized vivid screen colour approximate. Three adjacent full-height painted panels: a narrower black panel at left, white at centre, and wider black at right. Width divisions are approximate after allowing for the oblique gallery view; they are not measured dimensions. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek951-ellsworth-kelly-sculpture-on-the-wall; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
